meta.title: fix: prevent duplicate API calls to getSchedule and getTeamSchedule
meta.body_summary: Fix duplicate API calls to getSchedule and getTeamSchedule when layout shifts from default month_view to week_view/column_view by adding layout-based cache keys and staleTime management.

core_change_summary.description: In useScheduleForEvent hook (event.ts), added a cacheKey based on layout and other params, and set staleTime:0 to invalidate stale data. In useSchedule.ts, added layout to query key. In Booker.tsx, passed layout prop to components. Aimed to deduplicate API calls caused by layout shifts.
